body: ### Features - **AI Guard:** Support HTTPS_PROXY for evaluation requests [#10543](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10543) - **AppSec / AI Guard:** Support anthropic stream response [#10350](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10350) - **General:** Add OTLP adoption markers to trace payloads [#10482](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10482) - **LLM Observability:** Emit gen_ai.* APM tags when LLM Observability is disabled [#10437](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10437) - **Test Optimization:** Make failure media uploads opt-out [#10538](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10538) ### Fixes - **ci:** Preserve Vitest EFD message serialization [#10541](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10541) - **claude-agent-sdk:** Properly record system prompts [#10574](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10574) - **General:** Balance module-load events when require throws [#10535](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10535) - **LLM Observability:** Preserve surrounding braces when rendering prompts [#10494](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10494) - **oracledb:** Parse Easy Connect protocol URLs [#10416](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10416) - **Profiling:** Defer config updates while a shutdown export is in flight [#10532](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10532) - **Test Optimization:** Avoid reporting retry exhaustion without retries [#10549](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10549) - **Test Optimization:** Include backgrounds in impacted tests [#10567](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10567) - **Test Optimization:** Include bounded error details in test sessions [#10565](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10565) - **Test Optimization:** Report retry attempts once with correct outcomes [#10568](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10568) - **undici:** Prevent duplicate tracing of wrapped fetch requests [#10570](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10570) ### Internal (CI, Testing, Benchmarking) - **Dependencies:** Bump @datadog/openfeature-node-server from 2.3.0 to 2.4.0 in /vendor in the vendor-minor-and-patch-dependencies group across 1 directory [#10550](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10550) - **General:** Declare FLAKY_BENCHMARKS_REGEX and document benchmarks CI [#10476](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10476) - **llm-validation:** Skip validation on release branches [#10571](https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/10571) ### Contributors [](https://github.com/anmarchenko) [](https://github.com/BridgeAR) [](https://github.com/igoragoli) [](https://github.com/IlyasShabi) [](https://github.com/joeyzhao2018) [](https://github.com/juan-fernandez) [](https://github.com/komoken-dd) [](https://github.com/mhlidd) [](https://github.com/mz1119) [](https://github.com/pabloerhard) [](https://github.com/PROFeNoM) [](https://github.com/sabrenner) [](https://github.com/szegedi)
